title: Who Says a Playboy Can't Be the Top Scholar?
description: An AI-generated 3D-animated Chinese historical microdrama (谁说纨绔不能当状元) about Jiang Xiaobai, a notorious young nobleman believed to have bought his way to the rank of top imperial scholar.
descriptionMore: Unexpectedly summoned to court, Jiang Xiaobai investigates his elder brother's suspicious death and is drawn into poetry contests, family rivalries, and dangerous palace politics. Running to a reported 788 episodes, the series was one of Douyin's top AI-drama hits of 2026, with DataEye tracking a 2.579-billion-view increase on the platform in August alone.
